question: min max(x) + max(y) so that the one bit output is 1 with probability within eps of sigmoid((A - B) / T) for all 16 pairs (T = 0: 1 / 0.5 / 0)
reading: cost = cheapest design found: a numerical upper bound (searched table, LP decoder, the stored decoder rechecked in mpmath with the truncated tail charged). floor = lower bound for any encoder and decoder of that class, with its own status. No cost is proved optimal. Costs are scaled to error eps - 2e-8, so their relative excess over the scale that hits eps exactly is about 1e-6: quote them to 2 or 3 decimals. Floors are rounded down. A wider class never costs more: two channels <= one detector and arrival time <= one detector (add up the slots).
